## Introduction

This paper announces the venue and schedule for the fall WG21 meeting.

The committee will convene in Sofia, Bulgaria for plenary sessions and evening social events.

Hotel blocks are available near the convention center; registration opens next month.

Travel grants may be available for participants from underrepresented regions.
